resources.summary: Read recent editor Output panel messages, deduplicated and filterable by level, type, or substring.
use_when: diagnostics report console issues and you need the message bodies

resources.summary: Read deduplicated runtime errors from the debugger, distinct from console prints; optional stack traces.
use_when: the running game hit failures like null references or missing nodes

resources.summary: Read runtime warnings from the debugger panel as structured entries with file, line, and callstack.
use_when: diagnostics show a non-zero debugger warning count

resources.summary: Prioritized overview of editor console and runtime debugger errors and warnings, with complete counts and a trimmed noise tail.
use_when: first stop after any change, before targeted console or debugger reads
verifying a fix removed the errors it targeted

resources.summary: Bind to the open project and return engine health, project name and path, current and main scene, trimmed settings, and memory summary.
use_when: first call in every fresh session, to avoid guessing scene filenames
deliberately rebinding after the engine switched projects

resources.summary: Read a scene's node tree, with explicit depth and limit to avoid the engine's silent default truncation.
use_when: inspecting scene structure before or after mutations

resources.summary: Check one GDScript file for parse and compile errors without running the game.
use_when: after writing or editing a .gd file, to verify it compiles

resources.summary: Discover Summer Studio's guided workflow recipes: starter prompts, ordered steps, required tools, and honest support levels.
use_when: planning a multi-step asset workflow like sprite sheets or character packs

resources.summary: Search the asset library and import the best match into the project in one step, optionally adding 3D models to a scene.
use_when: the user asks to add a kind of asset, like 'add a tree to the scene'

resources.summary: Import an exact Summer asset id into the open project via the engine's import pipeline; optionally instantiate 3D models into a scene.
use_when: importing a just-generated or searched asset without guessing
placing a 3D model into an exact scene by parent path

resources.summary: Download one file from a URL and run Godot's full import pipeline so the asset is immediately usable.
use_when: importing a model, texture, or audio file from an external URL

resources.summary: Download multiple files by URL in one operation with a single filesystem scan afterwards.
use_when: importing several related files, like a model plus its textures

resources.summary: Create an input action if needed and bind keyboard or mouse events to it.
use_when: setting up player controls like jump, move, or interact

resources.summary: Get every editable property of a node with current values, types, and resource info.
use_when: before modifying a node, to understand its current state

resources.summary: Get all properties of a resource such as a material, mesh, shape, or environment.
use_when: reading sub-properties that the node inspector only names

resources.summary: Add an existing scene or 3D model file as a child node, composing scenes from prefabs.
use_when: placing a .tscn prefab or imported 3D model into a scene

resources.summary: Check whether the game is running; returns the active scene path when it is.
use_when: deciding whether to boot, restart, or capture the running game

resources.summary: Report how library entries worked out (worked, wrong, outdated, ...) so Summer can fix and re-rank them; fire-and-forget, opt-out honored.
use_when: a natural checkpoint after using library entries, batching all outcomes in one call
an entry was wrong, outdated, incomplete, or misrouted and Summer should know

resources.summary: List or search the signed-in user's generated and uploaded assets, returning exact asset ids plus file and import URLs.
use_when: retrieving an asset the user just generated before importing it
resolving phrases like 'the model I made' to an exact asset id

resources.summary: Open the project's configured main scene from project settings instead of guessing scene filenames.
use_when: any tool reports that no scene is open

resources.summary: Open a scene file in the editor to switch tabs.
use_when: switching the editor to an explicitly known scene path

resources.summary: Start the game (main scene or a specific scene) inside Summer Engine's viewport.
use_when: runtime verification after edits
testing one level or UI screen in isolation

resources.summary: Set one project.godot setting, like main scene, window size, renderer, or gravity.
use_when: configuring project-level behavior

resources.summary: Read a text file from the engine-bound project and return its full-file sha256 receipt for guarded overwrites.
use_when: reading project files through the engine
getting the sha256 required before overwriting a file

resources.summary: Remove a node and all its children from a scene; undoable, but destructive.
use_when: deleting scene content the user asked to remove

resources.summary: Replace a node with a different type or scene, preserving its tree position and children.
use_when: swapping a placeholder for a prefab or changing a body type

resources.summary: Safely replace text in an existing project file: unique match required by default, then a sha256-guarded write.
use_when: targeted edits to scripts, scenes, or config without resending the whole file

resources.summary: Save an explicit scene to disk, for standalone saves or save-as.
use_when: a standalone save or save-as is needed

resources.summary: Capture a frame from the editor viewport, an offscreen scene render, or the running game, returned as an actual image.
use_when: visually verifying layout, scale, framing, or runtime state

resources.summary: Search the Summer asset library and your own assets by keyword and meaning; returns names, types, preview and import-ready URLs.
use_when: finding an existing asset in the public library before generating a new one
locating a user's generated or uploaded asset by description

resources.summary: Select a node in the editor scene tree and show it in the inspector.
use_when: focusing the user's editor on a specific node

resources.summary: Set a node property using Godot string syntax for vectors, colors, transforms, and resource class names.
use_when: configuring nodes after adding them

resources.summary: Set a nested property on a resource attached to a node, like a collision shape size or material color.
use_when: modifying sub-properties of meshes, materials, or shapes

resources.summary: Detect and crop every distinct game asset from a generated sheet image, uploading named slices with bounding boxes.
use_when: splitting a generated asset or UI sheet into individually usable assets

resources.summary: Plan the right Summer workflow for a game-building task: skill routes, tool groups, confirmation gates, and verification steps.
use_when: starting any substantial AI game-building task, before mutating the project

resources.summary: Stop the running game.
use_when: runtime verification is finished
an existing instance must restart to observe changes

resources.summary: Create or safely overwrite one complete text file through the identity-bound engine; exactly one guard is required, so writes fail closed.
use_when: creating a new project file with the create-only guard
overwriting an existing file with its sha256 receipt
